title: 10 Best Rooftop Bars in Colombo — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best rooftop bars in Colombo, Sri Lanka — curated from Reddit reviews and travel blogs. ON14, The Bar On The Top, Cloud Red, Vistas, Sky Lounge & more.

places.name: ON14 Rooftop Lounge & Bar

redditQuotes.text: Looking for nightlife tonight in Colombo. Any bars or clubs? I really want to hit a rooftop bar somewhere.
redditQuotes.source: — r/srilanka · Sky bars in Colombo thread

places.verdict: Colombo's most popular rooftop bar — 1,500+ reviews, consistent cocktails, and an open-air terrace with panoramic views over the Indian Ocean. The go-to for first-timers.

comparison.best for: First-time visitors wanting a reliable rooftop experience with great views and live entertainment
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ from 1,551 Google reviews · Live music and sports on screens · Open-air terrace with ocean views · Part of Radisson Colombo
comparison.limitations: Can get crowded on weekends; service can slow during peak hours
comparison.what to order: Signature cocktails with Sri Lankan arrack as the base spirit — the bartenders are skilled at incorporating local flavors. The tapas menu is solid for sharing. Ask for a terrace seat facing west for sunset.

places.whatToOrder: Signature cocktails with Sri Lankan arrack as the base spirit — the bartenders are skilled at incorporating local flavors. The tapas menu is solid for sharing. Ask for a terrace seat facing west for sunset.
places.editorialSummary: Colombo's most popular rooftop bar — 1,500+ reviews, consistent cocktails, and an open-air terrace with panoramic views over the Indian Ocean. The go-to for first-timers.
places.bestFor: First-time visitors wanting a reliable rooftop experience with great views and live entertainment

places.name: The Bar On The Top — Granbell Hotel

redditQuotes.text: New Cool Hangout spot in the heart of Colombo. Granbell Hotel Colombo with an amazing view from the rooftop — 27th Floor overlooking Indian Ocean.

places.verdict: Colombo's newest and highest rooftop bar. The 27th-floor views from Granbell Hotel are genuinely breathtaking — Indian Ocean on one side, city skyline and Lotus Tower on the other. The adjacent Minori Japanese restaurant adds fine dining appeal.

comparison.best for: Sunset drinks with the most panoramic view in Colombo — 100 meters above Marine Drive
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ · Highest rooftop bar in Colombo · Natural-chic design · Adjacent infinity pool and jacuzzi for hotel guests · Minori Japanese fine dining next door
comparison.limitations: Walk-ins only (no reservations) — arrive early for sunset seats; newer so still building its reputation
comparison.what to order: Crafted cocktails and premium spirits. The international menu features sharing plates ideal for sunset. Insider tip: book a night at the hotel for pool and jacuzzi access with the same view.

places.whatToOrder: Crafted cocktails and premium spirits. The international menu features sharing plates ideal for sunset. Insider tip: book a night at the hotel for pool and jacuzzi access with the same view.
places.editorialSummary: Colombo's newest and highest rooftop bar. The 27th-floor views from Granbell Hotel are genuinely breathtaking — Indian Ocean on one side, city skyline and Lotus Tower on the other. The adjacent Minori Japanese restaurant adds fine dining appeal.
places.bestFor: Sunset drinks with the most panoramic view in Colombo — 100 meters above Marine Drive

places.name: Cloud Red — Cinnamon Red

redditQuotes.text: Rooftop bar at the Cinnamon Red has a nice view of the Lotus Tower at night.

places.verdict: The trendiest rooftop in Colombo. Cinnamon Red's 26th-floor Cloud Red mixes a stylish indoor lounge with a breezy outdoor terrace — city skyline views one way, Indian Ocean the other. The infinity pool is Instagram-famous.

comparison.best for: Trendy after-work drinks and socializing with city views — attracts a young, stylish crowd
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ hotel rating · Signature cocktails and mocktails · Tapas menu with seafood, meat, and vegetarian options · Stylish interior lounge + outdoor terrace
comparison.limitations: Gets busy on weekends; premium pricing compared to other Colombo bars
comparison.what to order: Signature cocktails and pitchers for sharing. The seafood tapas are well-reviewed. For the full experience, book a room at Cinnamon Red and swim in the rooftop infinity pool before sunset drinks.

places.whatToOrder: Signature cocktails and pitchers for sharing. The seafood tapas are well-reviewed. For the full experience, book a room at Cinnamon Red and swim in the rooftop infinity pool before sunset drinks.
places.editorialSummary: The trendiest rooftop in Colombo. Cinnamon Red's 26th-floor Cloud Red mixes a stylish indoor lounge with a breezy outdoor terrace — city skyline views one way, Indian Ocean the other. The infinity pool is Instagram-famous.
places.bestFor: Trendy after-work drinks and socializing with city views — attracts a young, stylish crowd

places.name: Vistas Bar — NH Collection

redditQuotes.text: While Movenpick sits at the heart of Colpetty surrounded by tall skyscrapers, their rooftop bar boasts a stunning view of the Indian Ocean. The best time of the day to visit would be during the sunset.
redditQuotes.source: — life.lk · 9 Best Rooftop Bars in Colombo review, 2025

places.verdict: The 360° views from the former Mövenpick (now NH Collection) are among Colombo's best. Vistas is a social meeting point with inspired cocktails, fusion shisha, and world-class sunset panoramas over both city and sea.

comparison.best for: 360° panoramic views of Colombo — the best all-around rooftop view in the city, especially at sunset
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ · True 360° view · Signature cocktails and fusion shisha · Sharing plates from around the world · Adjacent infinity pool for guests
comparison.limitations: Walk-ins only; the Colpetty location means no direct ocean frontage like Marine Drive bars
comparison.what to order: The Achcharu cocktail (achcharu pulp with tequila) is a local favorite that uses Sri Lankan pickle flavor in a martini glass. Try fusion shisha if you're into that. The sunset view from this height is arguably Colombo's best.

places.whatToOrder: The Achcharu cocktail (achcharu pulp with tequila) is a local favorite that uses Sri Lankan pickle flavor in a martini glass. Try fusion shisha if you're into that. The sunset view from this height is arguably Colombo's best.
places.editorialSummary: The 360° views from the former Mövenpick (now NH Collection) are among Colombo's best. Vistas is a social meeting point with inspired cocktails, fusion shisha, and world-class sunset panoramas over both city and sea.
places.bestFor: 360° panoramic views of Colombo — the best all-around rooftop view in the city, especially at sunset

places.name: Sky Lounge — The Kingsbury

redditQuotes.text: Rooftop bar at the Kingsbury has a nice view. If not the lobby bar is also great.

places.verdict: The Kingsbury's elegant Sky Lounge sits atop Colombo's historic Fort district with views over both the city and Indian Ocean. More refined and glamorous than the beachside hotel bars — this is where Colombo dresses up.

comparison.best for: Glamorous evenings with live entertainment and refined cocktails in Colombo's historic Fort quarter
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ · Chic and elegant atmosphere · Carefully crafted signature cocktails · Live entertainment · Fort district harbor and city views
comparison.limitations: Colombo's most expensive rooftop bar; opens at 5pm only (no daytime drinks); Fort area can be quiet after dark
comparison.what to order: Premium signature cocktails — the bartenders here are among Colombo's most skilled. The à la carte tapas menu pairs well with cocktails. Book a table facing the harbor for the best views.

places.whatToOrder: Premium signature cocktails — the bartenders here are among Colombo's most skilled. The à la carte tapas menu pairs well with cocktails. Book a table facing the harbor for the best views.
places.editorialSummary: The Kingsbury's elegant Sky Lounge sits atop Colombo's historic Fort district with views over both the city and Indian Ocean. More refined and glamorous than the beachside hotel bars — this is where Colombo dresses up.
places.bestFor: Glamorous evenings with live entertainment and refined cocktails in Colombo's historic Fort quarter

places.name: Sky Yard — Hotel MaRadha
places.address: 31, St Kilda's Lane, Marine Drive, Colombo 00300
places.verdict: A modern, lush rooftop with both a bar and restaurant next to MaRadha's impressive rooftop pool. Ocean and Port City views, live music on select nights, and more affordable cocktails than the big hotel chains.

comparison.best for: Relaxed sundowners, happy hour drinks, and evening entertainment at reasonable prices
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ · Affordable cocktails · Live music and trivia nights · Ocean and Port City views · Pool-adjacent atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Pool access for hotel guests only; can get crowded during events
comparison.what to order: Signature cocktails with local arrack, wine, or local beer. The exotic tapas menu is designed for sharing. Happy hour offers excellent value.

places.whatToOrder: Signature cocktails with local arrack, wine, or local beer. The exotic tapas menu is designed for sharing. Happy hour offers excellent value.
places.editorialSummary: A modern, lush rooftop with both a bar and restaurant next to MaRadha's impressive rooftop pool. Ocean and Port City views, live music on select nights, and more affordable cocktails than the big hotel chains.

places.name: Cloud Cafe & Bar — Colombo Court Hotel

redditQuotes.text: They also weren't joking about their Long Island! While most bars tend to water down their Long Island, the Cloud Café is quite generous with their portions of tequila, vodka, rum and gin.
redditQuotes.source: — life.lk · 9 Best Rooftop Bars in Colombo review

places.verdict: Colombo's best-value rooftop bar. Signature cocktails from just LKR 950 (under $3 USD), generous Long Island pours, live acoustic music on Thursdays, and a surprisingly peaceful atmosphere above the city noise. The spot for budget-conscious drinkers.

comparison.best for: Budget rooftop drinks with generous pours, live music, and a relaxed conversation-friendly atmosphere
comparison.strengths: 4.1★ · Colombo's most affordable rooftop cocktails · Live band on Thursdays · Full food menu with pizza, wraps, and mains · Spacious seating
comparison.limitations: Not the highest viewpoint; closes earlier on weekdays (11pm); less flashy than hotel competitors
comparison.what to order: The Mango Arrack Sour (LKR 950) uses local arrack with mango puree and lemon. Their Long Island is famously strong — generous tequila, vodka, rum, and gin with minimal Coke. The cheese nachos pair perfectly with cocktails.

places.whatToOrder: The Mango Arrack Sour (LKR 950) uses local arrack with mango puree and lemon. Their Long Island is famously strong — generous tequila, vodka, rum, and gin with minimal Coke. The cheese nachos pair perfectly with cocktails.
places.editorialSummary: Colombo's best-value rooftop bar. Signature cocktails from just LKR 950 (under $3 USD), generous Long Island pours, live acoustic music on Thursdays, and a surprisingly peaceful atmosphere above the city noise. The spot for budget-conscious drinkers.
places.bestFor: Budget rooftop drinks with generous pours, live music, and a relaxed conversation-friendly atmosphere

places.name: Ward7 — Jetwing Colombo Seven
places.verdict: An intimate rooftop restobar on the polished Jetwing Colombo Seven — less flashy than the mega-hotel bars but with a superior boutique atmosphere. The panoramic city views and creative cocktails make it a local favorite for romantic evenings.

comparison.best for: Romantic evenings and daytime relaxation with creative cocktails at a boutique hotel
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ hotel rating · Intimate and refined · Creative signature cocktails · Afternoon tea and bar bites · Rooftop infinity pool for guests
comparison.limitations: Smaller space — can fill up; Ward Place location is slightly inland from ocean views
comparison.what to order: Refreshing signature cocktails with local botanicals. The fresh juices and afternoon tea are excellent daytime options. Sharing plates are tapas-style and well-crafted.

places.whatToOrder: Refreshing signature cocktails with local botanicals. The fresh juices and afternoon tea are excellent daytime options. Sharing plates are tapas-style and well-crafted.

places.name: Botanik Rooftop Bistro & Bar
places.verdict: One of the few independent (non-hotel) rooftop bars in Colombo. Botanik in the Fort district has a younger, more energetic crowd, happy hour deals, and a relaxed vibe that feels less corporate than the hotel chains. Great for a night out.

comparison.best for: A night out with friends — younger crowd, dancing, happy hour deals, and a less hotel-chain atmosphere
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ · Independent bar (not hotel-attached) · Happy hour drinks · Dancing and social atmosphere · Fort district location near Lotus Tower
comparison.limitations: Outdoor seating with takeout only (no full dine-in listed); can get very loud on weekends
comparison.what to order: Cocktails, beer, and hard liquor are all well-represented. Take advantage of happy hour pricing for the best value. The food menu includes bar bites and sharing plates.

places.whatToOrder: Cocktails, beer, and hard liquor are all well-represented. Take advantage of happy hour pricing for the best value. The food menu includes bar bites and sharing plates.
places.editorialSummary: One of the few independent (non-hotel) rooftop bars in Colombo. Botanik in the Fort district has a younger, more energetic crowd, happy hour deals, and a relaxed vibe that feels less corporate than the hotel chains. Great for a night out.
places.bestFor: A night out with friends — younger crowd, dancing, happy hour deals, and a less hotel-chain atmosphere

places.name: Loft Lounge Bar
places.verdict: A quiet, intimate alternative for those who want great cocktails without the rooftop crowd. Located in the same building as Cloud Cafe, the Loft Lounge offers a more refined, low-key drinking experience with excellent beer and cocktail selections.

comparison.best for: Quiet, intimate drinks away from the rooftop crowds — ideal for couples or solo travelers
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ · Great cocktails and beer selection · Intimate setting · Solo dining friendly
comparison.limitations: Very new with few reviews; smaller space; not a traditional rooftop with panoramic views
comparison.what to order: Great beer selection and craft cocktails with dessert pairings. The intimate setting encourages conversation — perfect for a quieter evening.
